content.comment_body: I'm currently working on a project where I'm using an HMI screen for the first time. Communication is working well and I've created a few pages for my client. The only issue I'm facing is displaying and modifying the weekly timer's time. I've set this up in the tag table as a Word and I can edit it, but the value is shown in minutes. For example, if you want to enter 1:10, it is interpreted as 110 minutes, which is actually 1:50. My client will likely be dissatisfied if asked to convert times to minutes for input, which I would also like to avoid. Is there a way to separate the Word value so that hours and minutes can be set independently? Doing the conversion via math isn't an option since you can't link a reference in the weekly timer.
I found a solution to this issue. It wasn't working for me at first, but now it seems to function properly.

analysis.insight_summary: The user encountered challenges displaying and entering weekly timer values in an hh:mm format on an HMI screen, as the system initially allowed input only in total minutes. This limitation was problematic for usability and could lead to confusion for clients. Although a workaround was eventually found, the lack of intuitive hour and minute entry was a source of frustration.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to input and display time values in a clear hh:mm format instead of in total minutes, aiming for a more user-friendly and professional interface for customers.
